search_scope: Bounded primary literature/public repository audit; absence claims mean not located, never proven unavailable.
selection: Hummer1971 Table I for independent angular transfer; constructed Owocki2017 small-drag continuum control for stationary conservation/force verification. No candidate yet closes primordial thermodynamic wind launch.

candidates.availability: Published Table I, explicit equations; PDF SHA256 in acquisition registry. No original code located.
candidates.equations: Static conservative spherical grey transfer; source S=J, H=H0/r^2; angular variable Eddington factor.
candidates.eos: No material EOS; scattering problem also equivalent to grey LTE radiative equilibrium with true absorption.
candidates.opacity: Volume extinction chi=r^-n in specified units, n=1.5,2,3; isotropic scattering.
candidates.radiation: Full angle-dependent bolometric transfer; vacuum exterior.
candidates.boundaries: Central luminosity at infinite inward optical depth; no incident radiation at R. Computational inner diffusion boundary must be moved inward.
candidates.composition: No composition/population assumption is needed for the mathematical extinction law.
candidates.mass_radius_luminosity_inputs: Table I: n=2,R=10,H0=1, therefore L=16*pi^2; no stellar mass.
candidates.outputs: J(r), f(r), boundary H/J in Table I; other cases in figures.
candidates.deterministic_reproduction: Yes to the published numerical precision; core truncation and grids are independent numerical inputs.
candidates.selection: Selected independent thick-to-thin transfer reference; never counted as a stationary mass-loss benchmark.

candidates.availability: Exact analytic equation 24 and explicit dimensionless definitions; no original executable/data located in this bounded search.
candidates.equations: Stationary spherical mass, pressure-free momentum, photon-tiring energy. Eq24 w=(1-exp(-m*Gamma*x))/m-x. Finite w_base generalization documented.
candidates.eos: Gas pressure/enthalpy neglected. Full paper also treats radiation enthalpy; analytic reference neglects radiation drag.
candidates.opacity: Constant opacity; isotope/ionization algorithm not required by the limiting mathematical problem.
candidates.radiation: Analytic force from flux. Our new angular transfer tests its small-drag limit with measured omitted-drag size.
candidates.sonic: Zero-sound-speed limiting launch; mdot is an input, not a sonic eigenvalue.
candidates.boundaries: x=0 inner w=0 in paper; finite w_base=1e-4 in constructed control, L(0)=L0. No external illumination.
candidates.composition: Fixed scattering law only. Mapping kappa to partially ionized H/He is not justified.
candidates.mass_radius_luminosity_inputs: Gamma=L0/L_Edd,m=mdot*GM/(R*L0),vesc/c. Exact constructed inputs in grey_continuum_wind.json.
candidates.outputs: Analytic v,L,force at every radius; density from mass conservation, optical depth/photosphere by independent quadrature. No gas T/entropy/ionization.
candidates.deterministic_reproduction: Yes for the specified limiting equations; not a complete published thermodynamic star.
candidates.selection: Selected constructed stationary verification target because equations and outputs are exact; CONDITIONAL as a physical wind target. No figure fit, no hidden coefficients.

candidates.availability: Publicly indexed article equations; direct OUP HTML and ADS PDF downloads returned 403. No original code or tables located.
candidates.equations: Spherical moving grey transfer plus pressure-free momentum in Newtonian gravity; special-relativistic radiation transformations.
candidates.eos: Scattering models omit gas energy equation; separate isothermal examples prescribe thermal state.
candidates.opacity: Constant comoving isotropic scattering; absorption/emission optional separate family.
candidates.radiation: Full bolometric angle-dependent mixed-frame transfer, including radiation drag and work.
candidates.sonic: No gas-sonic regularity. Paper explicitly warns actual mass-loss is not determined by the chosen normalization.
candidates.boundaries: Uniform emitted Istar at Rstar, inward radiation absorbed, zero exterior illumination, Rout=100 Rstar.
candidates.composition: Unspecified by grey scattering family; no non-LTE populations.
candidates.mass_radius_luminosity_inputs: Gamma_star, tau_star, initial/final speed; displayed example Gamma_star=5,tau_star=3. Exact chosen figure-curve inputs not fully recovered in local record.
candidates.outputs: Published velocity/moment plots and approximate fit; no machine-readable profile found.
candidates.deterministic_reproduction: Equations reproducible; original figure-family reproduction not certified by this audit.
candidates.selection: Source for exact-frame transfer, not claimed as a completed published wind replication. Fit coefficients unused.

candidates.availability: Public C code, atomic data, parameter files; exact source paths/hashes in candidate_source_files.json.
candidates.equations: Monte Carlo ionization, thermal balance and spectral transfer on prescribed/imported flow.
candidates.eos: Iterated gas ionization/thermal state; not a solved stationary hydrodynamic EOS/energy eigenproblem in the supplied star model.
candidates.opacity: Frequency-dependent atomic processes; standard80.dat in inspected star setup.
candidates.radiation: Macro-atom/escape probability options; inspected star.pf uses ml93 ionization and escape_prob, adiabatic cooling.
candidates.sonic: Velocity beta law and mdot prescribed; no gas sonic eigenvalue in inspected setup.
candidates.boundaries: Blackbody core; absorbing surface; spherical wind from 1.32e12 to 1e13 cm.
candidates.composition: Atomic dataset-defined mixture; exact numerical abundance vector not extracted in this audit, so not represented as primordial H/He.
candidates.outputs: Spectra, ionization, temperature; density/velocity mostly imposed. CMFGEN benchmark doc inspected is a heading without a runnable setup.
candidates.deterministic_reproduction: Code/input reproducible with pinned atomic files and random seed/statistical convergence; seed not specified in inspected parameter file.
candidates.selection: Highest availability tier and relevant future non-LTE backend; cannot validate envelope mass-loss selection on its own. Not built or coupled in Report 11.

candidates.availability: Public source, parameter files, regression logs.
candidates.equations: Spherical hydro plus CAK line-ensemble force, radial or finite-disc/cutoff variants.
candidates.eos: Isothermal or ideal adiabatic option; source documents a floor temperature for adiabatic case.
candidates.opacity: Electron continuum plus parameterized line ensemble (Gayley qbar, CAK alpha).
candidates.radiation: Parameterized line acceleration; no full thick-to-thin continuum intensity field in this setup.
candidates.sonic: CAK radiative critical behavior; different from continuum gas-sonic launch.
candidates.boundaries: Specified base density, velocity ghost treatment; exterior outflow. Exact source/parameter files acquired.
candidates.composition: He abundance sets mean molecular weight; line ensemble is not metal-free recombination opacity.
candidates.mass_radius_luminosity_inputs: Mstar=50Msun,Rstar=20Rsun,Twind=40000K,rhobound=2e-11g/cm3,beta=.5; luminosity derived from Rstar and Twind.
candidates.outputs: Density, velocity, line acceleration, mass loss and logs.
candidates.deterministic_reproduction: Yes for pinned code/setup and converged numerical choices; not executed here.
candidates.selection: Strong reproducibility, different driving physics; rejected as sole validation target for primordial continuum winds.

candidates.availability: Public Fortran, sample input/output, optical-property files, manual.
candidates.equations: Spherical continuum transfer/radiative equilibrium; optional dust-driven hydrodynamic density (manual type3), analytic alternative type4.
candidates.eos: Dust radiative equilibrium and grain/gas wind assumptions; not a H/He ionization EOS.
candidates.opacity: Grain optical constants and specified size/abundance distributions, including supplied grey absorption file.
candidates.sonic: Dust wind approximation; not gas-sonic H/He recombination launch.
candidates.boundaries: Central source spectrum, inner dust temperature, shell extent and optical depth; wind mode adds explicit dust dynamics assumptions.
candidates.composition: User grain mixture and gas-to-dust scaling. Acquired sphere3 has a dust mixture and imported density (type5), NOT a hydro wind sample.
candidates.mass_radius_luminosity_inputs: Dimensionless luminosity/radius scaling and inner dust T; inspected sphere3 Tinner=1000K with quasar.dat and collapse.dat.
candidates.outputs: Temperature, spectrum, intensity and density; velocity/mdot in appropriate wind mode.
candidates.deterministic_reproduction: Yes with pinned source and all input optical tables; exact sample acquired is not a hydrodynamic verification.
candidates.selection: Excellent transfer source availability; dust physics and sample scope make it unsuitable as sole quasi-star wind target. Not executed.

candidates.availability: Complete limiting equations; digitized profiles and QStarS reproduction archived in earlier reports.
candidates.eos: Radiation dominated, no H/He recombination EOS.
candidates.radiation: Heuristic thick/thin Eddington and flux bridges, not independently angle-validated in original QStarS implementation.
candidates.sonic: Radiation sound-speed Mach boundary range; not gas-sonic eigenvalue.
candidates.boundaries: Base Mach approximately .8 with quoted spread; terminal velocity shooting.
candidates.mass_radius_luminosity_inputs: alpha, energy, beta and base Mach; benchmark YAMLs retained.
candidates.outputs: v,radiation energy, luminosity, Mach and figures.
candidates.deterministic_reproduction: Equations yes; one published caption/curve energy discrepancy remains.
candidates.selection: Keep alternative family; do not call an old bridge closure newly validated by changing its label.

candidates.availability: Paper/figures available; exact original EOS/opacity code and machine profiles not located. Report 10 evidence retained, not repeated.
candidates.equations: Stationary spherical gas plus radiation diffusion and total-energy invariant.
candidates.eos: LTE H/He ionization; original implementation details not fully recoverable.
candidates.radiation: Rosseland diffusion to a paper photospheric cutoff.
candidates.sonic: Gas-sonic critical regularity; printed sonic r,rho,T.
candidates.boundaries: Critical state specified; no full external transfer boundary.
candidates.outputs: Density, velocity, T,L,opacity profiles; published red escape branch not reproduced.
candidates.deterministic_reproduction: Not to required accuracy from located record. No new exact inputs found to justify repeating attribution.
candidates.selection: Additional failing benchmark only; no longer sole primary target.

candidates.radiation: MESA atmosphere/interior approximation, no resolved stationary wind transfer in inspected extras.
